onboarding.termsAgree: By signing up you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and confirm that you are at least 18 years old.

kyc.title: Hi {username}, welcome to Fansocial! We're thrilled to have you onboard.
kyc.description: Complete creator verification to access the dashboard.
kyc.description1: Before you can access your account, we kindly request you to complete the Know Your Customer (KYC) verification process. This step is essential to ensure the security and integrity of our platform. To expedite the process, please ensure that you have your identity documents, such as a valid government-issued ID or passport, as well as address proof documents, readily available.
kyc.description2: Once your KYC has been successfully verified, you'll have full access to your account and can start enjoying all the features and benefits our platform has to offer. Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to serving you!
kyc.description3: Please note that the privacy and confidentiality of your personal information are of utmost importance to us. Our servers do not store your identity documents at any stage. If you have any questions or require assistance during the verification procedure, our support team is available to assist you.
